Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a typical tile installation take?

Most residential installations take between 2 to 5 days, depending on the size of the area and the complexity of the design.

What materials do you work with?

We specialize in premium porcelain, marble, ceramic, and luxury vinyl plank flooring. Our team handles every material with precision.

Do you offer tile repair services?

Yes, we provide expert tile repair and replacement services for residential and commercial properties in the Tampa Bay area.

How do I prepare my space for remodeling?

We handle all prep work, including removing old flooring and fixtures, to ensure a clean and professional installation environment.

What is the warranty on your work?

We provide a comprehensive warranty on all our installations to ensure your investment in luxury finishes lasts for years to come.
